segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for making time. I had us down to review the revised quote for 42 seats and the May 15 go-live. Does that still line up on your side?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that still works. We confirmed 38 standard users and 4 admin users. The only thing I wanted to double-check was the first invoice timing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sure. The order form has the annual subscription starting May 15, with the first invoice issued on signing. Net 30 terms, so if you sign this week, payment would be due around May 10.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that’s fine. Finance asked whether implementation is on the same invoice or separate.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It’s separate. Subscription is $48,720 for the year, and implementation is a one-time $6,500 services fee. Both are listed on the order form, but billing can issue two invoices if that’s easier.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Separate would be better for us. And the implementation scope still includes the two data imports and the admin training session, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Two historical data imports, one 90-minute admin training, and the go-live support window during the week of May 15. Anything beyond that would be handled as standard support unless you request more services.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Legal was okay with the 12-month term and auto-renewal as long as the notice period is 60 days.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, the current draft says either party can opt out with 60 days’ written notice before renewal. I’ll resend the order form with the split-invoice note added.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it over today and I’ll route it for signature. I think we can turn it around by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send it in the next hour, and once it’s signed we’ll get the kickoff call scheduled for the week of April 29.
